messages:
Kai Suzuki: tiny personal drop: we adopted a senior golden named Juniper this weekend and i start my new role as Eng Manager next Monday. doing both at once, send tips 970 :dog: :tada:
Bea Morales: WHAT!!! juniper is the best name. congrats on the manager role too!! when is meet-the-dog in the office? :heart_eyes:
Kai Suzuki: thinking friday lunch? Juniper is very polite (and loves snacks). also low-key celebration for the role would be lovely 64f
Tom Rivers: congrats!!! ill bring a bagel box and dog treats (if allowed). quick poll: :bagel: bagels, :cake: cake, :paw_prints: treats-only (no human food), :thumbsup: just come by
Bea Morales: :bagel:
Ivy: :paw_prints:
HR-Bot: reminder: check building pet policy before bringing animals to common areas. Link: https://intranet.company/pets-policy
Kai Suzuki: noted re: policy, i'll confirm with facilities. Juniper is vaccinated and mellow. also dietary note: gluten-free on one bagel row pls :relieved:
Tom Rivers: noted GF row.
Bea Morales: small idea  2-min welcome & a tiny congratulations card for Kai. react :speech_balloon: for card, :zzz: for no card
Ivy: :speech_balloon:
Tom Rivers: :speech_balloon:
Kai Suzuki: card sounds sweet but keep it short please. i may tear up.
HR-Bot: calendar event created: "Juniper Meet + Kai Congrats" Fri 12:30-1:00 Kitchenette. https://calendar.company/evt/2145001234
Bea Morales: sending a quick congrats thread now on behalf of the team 495
Kai Suzuki: thank you all. Juniper sends tail wags. see you Friday :)
